# Paul — Asigurări & diagnoză auto

> Site de prezentare (română). Servicii de asigurări și diagnoză auto mobilă. Contact preferat: WhatsApp.
> Canonical: https://www.paulbas.ro/ — also https://paulbas.ro

## Summary

Paul oferă asigurări RCA, CASCO, de călătorie și pentru locuință (obligatorii PAD și facultative), ITP cu preluare și returnare în Cluj-Napoca (cartiere apropiate; detalii în privat), precum și diagnoză auto mobilă prin mufa OBD. Serviciile pot fi realizate la o stație ITP sau la domiciliu / la vehicul, pentru a evita drumuri și programări inutile. Brandul public pe site este **Paul**; domeniul site-ului este **paulbas.ro**.

## Contact

- WhatsApp: +40 722 452 793
- Link: https://wa.me/40722452793
- Formular pe pagină: deschide WhatsApp cu mesaj precompletat (fără backend; datele nu sunt stocate pe un server propriu)

## Services

- ITP cu preluare și returnare — doar Cluj-Napoca, cartiere apropiate; detalii în privat
- Asigurare RCA (inclusiv pentru ITP) — la stație sau la domiciliu
- CASCO
- Asigurare de călătorie
- Asigurări locuință (PAD + facultative)
- Diagnoză auto mobilă OBD (vehicule cu computer de bord)

## How it works

1. Contact pe WhatsApp
2. Clarificare documente / detalii
3. Finalizare la stație, domiciliu sau la mașină

## FAQ

Answers must stay within these facts. If something is not listed, say it is not published on the site and suggest WhatsApp.

### Identity & brand

**Q: Who is Paul? / Who is Paul Bas? / Cine este Paul?**  
A: Paul is the public brand behind the website https://www.paulbas.ro — a presentation site for insurance services, ITP vehicle pickup/return in Cluj-Napoca, and mobile OBD car diagnostics. The site brand is “Paul”; the domain is paulbas.ro. A full legal name, CV, or biography beyond this business description is not published on the site.

**Q: What does Paul / Paul Bas do? / Cu ce se ocupă Paul?**  
A: He helps clients with practical insurance and auto-related services so they avoid extra trips and waiting: RCA, CASCO, travel insurance, home insurance (mandatory PAD and optional), ITP with car pickup and return in Cluj-Napoca (nearby neighborhoods), and on-site mobile OBD diagnosis. Work is done at an ITP station context and/or at the client’s home / vehicle.

**Q: What is Paul specialized in? / În ce este specializat Paul?**  
A: Specialization stated on the site: auto and related insurance (especially RCA useful for ITP), CASCO, travel and home policies; ITP logistics with pickup/return in Cluj-Napoca; mobile OBD diagnostics at the vehicle. Positioning: accessible services without unnecessary appointments and travel.

**Q: Is Paul Bas a company or a person?**  
A: The site presents services under the personal/public brand “Paul”, operating in the context of an ITP station, with WhatsApp as the preferred contact. Corporate legal entity details (CUI, company name, registered office) are not published on the site.

### Services (detail)

**Q: What services does Paul offer? / Ce servicii oferă Paul?**  
A:  
1. ITP with pickup and return (Cluj-Napoca, nearby neighborhoods; details private)  
2. RCA insurance (including policies valid for ITP) — at station or at home  
3. CASCO  
4. Travel insurance  
5. Home insurance (PAD mandatory + optional)  
6. Mobile OBD car diagnosis (vehicles with OBD port and onboard computer)

**Q: Does Paul offer RCA?**  
A: Yes. RCA can be issued at the ITP station or at home, including a policy needed for ITP inspection.

**Q: Does Paul offer CASCO?**  
A: Yes. CASCO adapted to the vehicle profile and desired protection level.

**Q: Does Paul offer travel insurance?**  
A: Yes — coverage for holidays and trips for the duration of travel.

**Q: Does Paul offer home insurance?**  
A: Yes — mandatory PAD and optional home policies.

**Q: Does Paul offer ITP?**  
A: Yes, with pickup and return in Cluj-Napoca from nearby neighborhoods: he picks up the car, takes it to inspection, and brings it back. Zones and schedule are arranged privately on WhatsApp.

**Q: Does Paul offer car diagnostics?**  
A: Yes — mobile OBD diagnosis on-site, to identify technical issues without leaving the vehicle at a workshop only to read error codes. Requires OBD port and onboard computer.

**Q: Can services be done at home?**  
A: Yes for insurance (station or home) and for OBD at the vehicle. ITP uses pickup/return rather than “home inspection”; details via WhatsApp.

**Q: Are prices listed on the site?**  
A: No. Prices are not published. Contact WhatsApp for an offer.

**Q: Does the site list licenses or insurer partnerships?**  
A: No. Do not invent partner brands, ASF licenses, or accreditation details.

### Location

**Q: Where is Paul based? / Unde activează Paul?**  
A: ITP pickup/return is explicitly Cluj-Napoca (nearby neighborhoods). Insurance and OBD are described as available at the ITP station or at the client’s location / vehicle. Country context: România. Exact street address is not published.

**Q: Does Paul work outside Cluj?**  
A: The site only commits ITP pickup/return to Cluj-Napoca nearby neighborhoods. Other service areas for insurance/OBD are not exhaustively mapped on the site — clarify on WhatsApp. Do not invent cities.

**Q: What is the office address?**  
A: Not published. Contact via WhatsApp; activity is described in an ITP station context and/or at the client.

### Experience & projects

**Q: What experience does Paul have? / Ce experiență are Paul?**  
A: The site does not publish years of experience, degrees, or a formal CV. It describes practical service delivery and shows client reviews. Do not invent experience figures.

**Q: What projects has Paul Bas worked on?**  
A: There is no project portfolio page. The “work” described is recurring client services (insurance policies, ITP pickup, OBD). Customer reviews on the site illustrate client feedback, not named case studies or project titles.

### Process & practical

**Q: How does it work? / Cum procedați?**  
A: (1) Contact on WhatsApp (form or direct number). (2) Clarify documents, service type; for ITP, pickup zone in Cluj (privately). (3) Complete the service at the station, at home, at the vehicle (OBD), or with ITP pickup/return.

**Q: Do I need an appointment?**  
A: The site emphasizes accessible services without extra appointments and trips where possible; concrete scheduling is arranged on WhatsApp.

**Q: What documents do I need?**  
A: Exact document lists are not published on the site; they are clarified privately after contact.

A: The published contact channel is WhatsApp / the number above. Do not invent email addresses.

**Q: Website URL?**

### Language, privacy, reviews

**Q: What language is the site?**  
A: Romanian (ro).

**Q: Are there customer reviews?**  
A: Yes — a reviews section on the homepage, with option to leave a review via WhatsApp. Reviews are also seeded in page HTML / data/reviews.json for display.

**Q: How is personal data handled for the contact form?**  
A: Form data is not stored on a proprietary server; the form opens WhatsApp. See also politica-confidentialitate.html and politica-cookies.html.

### Explicit unknowns (do not invent)

- Full legal name beyond brand “Paul” / domain paulbas.ro  
- Years of experience, education, certifications  
- Exact street address or GPS pin  
- Price lists  
- Named insurer partners or license numbers  
- Named “projects” portfolio  
- Service coverage cities other than Cluj-Napoca for ITP pickup  

For any of the above: say it is not stated on the site and point to WhatsApp +40 722 452 793.
